// Build the Claude request for this ticket.
const CLASSIFIER = {"model": "claude-opus-5-5", "instructions": "You triage escalations in an AI training-data operation (annotation, LLM evaluation, data collection). Annotators, team leads and project managers raise issues through a form. Classify the issue so it reaches the right team with the right urgency. Judge only from the text; do not invent details.

CATEGORY:
- tooling_outage: the labeling tool, platform or a required system is down, erroring or unusably slow
- access_issue: one person or a few people cannot log in or lack permissions
- guideline_question: unclear or conflicting labeling guideline, edge case with no rule
- data_quality: bad or corrupted source data, wrong batch content, systematic labeling errors found in QA
- capacity_risk: staffing, absence or throughput problem that threatens a deadline
- client_request: a client asks for a change, report, extra volume or a deadline move
- other: anything else

IMPACT (how much work is affected):
- high: a whole team, site, workstream or client delivery
- medium: several people or one batch
- low: one person or a single item

URGENCY (how soon it hurts delivery):
- high: work is blocked now or a deadline within 24 hours is at risk
- medium: affects this week's delivery
- low: no near-term deadline impact

CONFIDENCE (0-1): below 0.6 if the text is too vague to classify reliably.", "schema": {"type": "object", "properties": {"category": {"type": "string", "enum": ["tooling_outage", "access_issue", "guideline_question", "data_quality", "capacity_risk", "client_request", "other"]}, "impact": {"type": "string", "enum": ["high", "medium", "low"]}, "urgency": {"type": "string", "enum": ["high", "medium", "low"]}, "summary": {"type": "string", "description": "One line, under 15 words, for the queue view."}, "confidence": {"type": "number"}, "reasoning": {"type": "string", "description": "One sentence explaining impact and urgency."}}, "required": ["category", "impact", "urgency", "summary", "confidence", "reasoning"], "additionalProperties": false}};
const body = $input.first().json.body ?? $input.first().json;
const ticket = {
  ticket_id: 'ESC-' + Date.now().toString(36).toUpperCase(),
  created_at: new Date().toISOString(),
  reporter: String(body.reporter ?? 'unknown').slice(0, 200),
  text: String(body.text ?? '').slice(0, 4000),
};
const request = {
  model: CLASSIFIER.model,
  max_tokens: 2000,
  fallbacks: 'default',
  output_config: { format: { type: 'json_schema', schema: CLASSIFIER.schema } },
  messages: [{ role: 'user', content: CLASSIFIER.instructions + '

<reporter>' + ticket.reporter + '</reporter>
<issue>
' + ticket.text + '
</issue>' }],
};
return [{ json: { ticket, request } }];
